show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Building Durable Real Estate Portfolios at Morgan Stanley – Lauren Hochfelder (EP.514)
summary:
We also
touch on riskier areas of real estate and Lauren’s new role adding
infrastructure to her real estate oversight. Lauren joined Morgan
Stanley as an investment banking analyst directly out of Yale 26
years ago and has spent her entire career at the firm, helping
build one of the industry's leading platforms. Our conversation traces Lauren's journey from analyst
to Global Head and the evolution of Morgan Stanley's real estate
business before, during, and after the Global Financial Crisis.
